title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Determine the Amount of Illegal Gains in Criminal Cases of Producing and Selling Counterfeit and Substandard Products

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on How to Determine the "Amount of Illegal Gains" in Cases of Producing or Selling Fake or Substandard Products
Fa Fu [1995] No. 3
Higher People's Court of Hubei Province:
We have received your court's E Gao Fa [1995] No. 94 "Request for Instructions on Understanding of 'Illegal Gains' in the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishing Crimes of Producing or Selling Fake or Substandard Commodities". Upon study, the reply is as follows:
The "amount of illegal gains" as prescribed in the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishing Crimes of Producing or Selling Fake or Substandard Commodities shall mean the amount of profits gained from producing or selling fake or substandard products.
July 5, 1995
